control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: loss of containment at HO-9402 during routine operation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on HO-9402 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating in reduced visibility, specifically working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions. HO-9402 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during routine operation while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 26 November 2020 an incident occurred on HO-9402 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during routine operation, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
